reasons: Section 20 contains a full Vendor defend/indemnify obligation covering third-party IP infringement/misappropriation of the Services and Deliverables (20.1) plus breach of Applicable Law, Customer Data breach caused by Vendor, and gross negligence/wilful misconduct/fraud (20.2), matching the preferred position and the model language.

Standard indemnity procedure (prompt notice, cooperation at indemnifier's expense, control of defence, prejudice-limited delay excuse, settlement consent) is present in 20.4, and 20.5 adds procure/modify/replace/refund remedies additive to the defence obligation.

Customer's indemnity in 20.3 is appropriately narrow (unmodified Customer-supplied material used as authorized; Customer's violation of law) with carve-outs for Vendor Technology, modification, combination and Vendor instructions — no one-sided exposure.

Indemnification obligations are Excluded Claims under 21.3, so Vendor's indemnity is outside the liability cap, which is better for us than the fallback 3x super-cap; no redline or comment is appropriate for a compliant finding.
Rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs and no comment was proposed, consistent with the claimed compliant status.
